html:
G'oya

Ikki bosqich. Avval har bir mijozning jami xaridini hisoblaymiz, buyurtmasizlarga 0. Keyin har bir mijozni shu ro'yxat bo'yicha o'z shahrining o'rtachasi bilan solishtiramiz. Birinchi bosqich natijasi ikki joyda kerak, shuning uchun uni WITH ga chiqaramiz.

Yechim

WITH t AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.name, c.city,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders o
                   WHERE o.customer_id = c.id), 0) AS total
  FROM customers c
)
SELECT id, name, total
FROM t
WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(t2.total) FROM t t2 WHERE t2.city = t.city)

Buyurtmasi yo'q mijoz uchun ichki SUM NULL beradi, COALESCE uni 0 ga aylantiradi. Pastdagi AVG korrelyatsiyalangan: t2.city = t.city o'rtachani joriy mijozning shahri bilan cheklaydi.

Namunada Toshkentda Aziz 320 000, Dilnoza 100 000, Sardor 0: o'rtacha 140 000, faqat Aziz o'tadi. Samarqandda Jasur 50 000, Malika 70 000: o'rtacha 60 000, Malika o'tadi.

Tuzoqlar

Buyurtmasizlarni yo'qotish. Jamilar oddiy JOIN va GROUP BY bilan hisoblansa, Sardor ro'yxatga umuman tushmaydi va Toshkent o'rtachasi 140 000 o'rniga 210 000 bo'ladi. Shart esa ularni 0 bilan hisoblashni aytgan:

Noto'g'riWITH t AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.name, c.city, SUM(o.amount) AS total
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city
)
SELECT id, name, total
FROM t
WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(t2.total) FROM t t2 WHERE t2.city = t.city)

Umumiy o'rtacha bilan solishtirish ham xato. Namunadagi besh mijozning o'rtachasi 108 000, Malika bu chegaradan o'tolmaydi, holbuki Samarqandda u o'rtachadan yuqori.

Shart "yuqori" deydi: o'rtachaga teng mijoz chiqmaydi. Shaharda bitta mijoz bo'lsa, u o'rtachaning o'zi.
